The patient has a left atrial volume index of 34.89 mL/m2, which is indicative of left atrial enlargement.
The patient has a third-degree AV block with a minimum heart rate of 36 beats/min, which is indicative of complete heart block.
The patient has a history of essential hypertension and an elevated blood pressure of 150/78 mm Hg.
The patient's ECG findings show sinus rhythm with first-degree atrioventricular block, which explains the uncovered fact of a PR interval of 360 ms.
